title: Fix Admin Users list visibility and enforce exact chat request accept/reject flow (including 24h resend rule and permanent 1:1 chat)

requirements.text: Update the Admin Users screen so an admin ALWAYS sees the full list of users (approved + unapproved) in the existing /admin/users screen (do not create a new admin screen), while preserving the current Admin layout and actions menu structure.

quotes: Admin must ALWAYS see the full list of users (approved + unapproved)

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /admin/users shows a single list/table containing all users (approved, unapproved/pending, rejected, blocked) without requiring any filter toggles to see them.
The screen still uses the existing AdminLayout and AdminRouteGuard flow and does not introduce new routes/screens for user management.
No working admin actions are removed or hidden as a side effect of the list change.

requirements.text: Ensure that on the Admin Users list view, user details remain permanently visible in the list row (not only inside a dialog): photo, name, email, phone number, and signup date/time (from users.createdAt) must be visible for every user in the list (role-based hiding is not allowed for these fields).

quotes: All user details (photo, name, email, phone, signup data) must remain permanently visible

acceptanceCriteria: Each user row in /admin/users visibly displays: avatar/photo, full name, email, phone number, and a human-readable signup date derived from createdAt.
These fields remain visible when the list is scrolled and regardless of the user status (approved/pending/rejected/blocked).
The existing “View Details” dialog (PendingUserDetailsDialog) may remain, but it is optional and must not be the only place where these core fields are visible.

requirements.text: Keep Admin actions functional at all times on /admin/users for every user: approve, block, delete, and make helper admin (promote) must work without breaking the list UI or requiring a page refresh; the list must update after each action.

quotes: Admin actions (approve, block, delete, make helper admin) must stay functional at all times

acceptanceCriteria: After each admin action is performed, the affected user row updates to reflect the new state (e.g., approved status, blocked state, role) without manual refresh.
Actions remain accessible for the appropriate admin roles (super admin vs helper admin) as currently intended, but core visibility of user details remains unchanged.
If delete is not currently implemented, add it in the same existing actions pattern (dropdown + confirmation) and ensure it removes the user from the list immediately after success.

requirements.text: Enforce the exact Chat Request UI logic on the approved users list: (1) any user can send a chat request to another approved user; (2) the sender must ONLY see “Request Sent” after sending; (3) the receiver must see Accept/Reject ONLY when request.toUserId === currentUserId AND request.status === "pending".

quotes:
Chat Request Logic (VERY IMPORTANT):
– Any user can send a chat request to another approved user
– Sender should ONLY see “Request Sent”
– Receiver should see Accept / Reject ONLY if:
  request.toUserId === currentUserId
  AND request.status === "pending"

acceptanceCriteria: In the ApprovedUsersListView, Accept/Reject controls render only for incoming requests where (toUserId == current user) AND status == pending.
For any sent request, the sender’s UI shows only “Request Sent” (no Accept/Reject, no extra buttons) while it remains pending.
No other request statuses accidentally surface Accept/Reject controls (e.g., accepted/rejected must not show those controls).

requirements.text: After a receiver Accepts a pending chat request, open a permanent private 1-to-1 chat room between the two users and display a standard chat UI with message list + chat input; the chat must remain accessible in the future (not a temporary session).

quotes:
After Accept:
– A private 1-to-1 chat room must open permanently
– Chat input and messages must appear normally

acceptanceCriteria: Accepting a request transitions the UI into a 1-to-1 chat room view for that pair (either by navigation or in-place, matching the existing routing approach).
The chat room view contains: a message history area and an input box that can send new messages.
After reload/sign-in later, the accepted chat still appears under the user’s Chats (ChatScreen) and reopens correctly.
The solution uses the existing project structure and routing approach (no new project, no major restructure).

requirements.text: After a receiver Rejects a pending chat request: (1) the sender must clearly see that the request was rejected; (2) the sender can re-send a request to the same receiver ONLY after 24 hours have passed since the rejection.

quotes:
After Reject:
– Sender must clearly see that the request was rejected
– Sender can re-send request ONLY after 24 hours

acceptanceCriteria: When a request is rejected, the sender’s UI clearly shows a rejected state for that target user (not ambiguous).
Attempting to re-send within 24 hours is blocked (UI disabled and/or backend/client function throws with a clear error message).
After 24 hours have elapsed, the sender can send a new request to the same receiver and then sees only “Request Sent” again.
The 24-hour rule is enforced based on stored timestamps in Firestore (not only in-memory timers) so it persists across reloads/devices.

requirements.text: Ensure changes are verifiably visible in Draft: after implementing each missing piece above, update the relevant screens so that the behavior change can be confirmed immediately in the Draft preview without requiring undocumented steps.

quotes:
If a change is applied, it MUST be visible in DRAFT.
If nothing changes in Draft, it means nothing was actually implemented.

acceptanceCriteria: Draft preview shows updated /admin/users behavior (all users visible + permanent user details).

Draft preview shows updated chat request behaviors (sender-only “Request Sent”, receiver-only Accept/Reject for pending incoming, reject state visibility, 24h resend gating, and accept opens chat UI).
No unrelated UI redesign occurs while making these fixes.

constraints: Do NOT redesign, restructure, or experiment; implement only missing pieces in the SAME structure.
Do NOT touch anything that is already working; make minimal, scoped changes.
Do NOT create a new project.
Do NOT move logic from one place to another (preserve existing file/flow structure).

Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Adding group chats or chat discovery beyond the existing approved users list.
Introducing new authentication providers (only existing auth flows).
Replacing Firebase with a different backend or database.
Any visual redesign beyond what is necessary to display the required fields/states.

preferencesToAdd: Prefer minimal, step-by-step fixes that preserve existing structure; no redesign/restructure; changes must be visible in Draft.
miscToAdd: Chat + Admin + Request system must follow screenshots and specified request visibility rules; sender sees only 'Request Sent'; receiver sees Accept/Reject only for pending incoming requests; rejected requests have 24h resend cooldown; accept creates permanent 1:1 chat with messages/input.
